i1_governing_problem_and_scale: Governing problem: how test-based conformity results, and the common conformity specifications on which they rest, are made usable across Member States for type approval of mass-produced telecommunications terminal equipment (initial stage of mutual recognition), including the Member State option to suspend recognition. Identified from the text independently of any expected global property.

A further candidate consequence (a feedback route from suspension ground (b) to withdrawal of the specification from the list and a further CEPT brief) is NOT asserted because the identity of "the list published" in A8.P4 with the references published under A6.P1.sub2 and A6.P2 is not stated (UNC).
